<a id="distance_bands"></a>
### [`distance_bands`](../../../../src/ai/ai_tables.asm#L51) `$C889-$C8B0`

*data*

Distance band (0-7) for each distance between the fighters in $aa (0-39).

- **Read by:** [`ai_choose_moves`](computer_moves.md#ai_choose_moves)

<a id="ai_row_ptrs"></a>
### [`ai_row_ptrs`](../../../../src/ai/ai_tables.asm#L56) `$C8B1-$C966`

*data*

Pointers to the AI row of each pose $00-$5a of the other fighter. Entries $1b and $1f point to ai_row_15. Build V 05 05 87 points them to ai_row_02 and ai_row_0b.

- **Read by:** [`ai_choose_moves`](computer_moves.md#ai_choose_moves)

<a id="ai_row_00"></a>
### [`ai_row_00`](../../../../src/ai/ai_tables.asm#L81) `$C967-$C96E`

*data*

AI rows, 8 bytes each: one byte for each distance band. The byte selects an AI joystick row.

- **Entry of:** [`ai_row_ptrs`](../../tables.md#ai_row_ptrs)

<a id="ai_row_01"></a>
### [`ai_row_01`](../../../../src/ai/ai_tables.asm#L84) `$C96F-$C976`

*data*

Byte 0 selects AI joystick row $16. Build V 05 05 87 has $13.

<a id="ai_row_15"></a>
### [`ai_row_15`](../../../../src/ai/ai_tables.asm#L127) `$CA0F-$CA16`

*data*

Not in build V 05 05 87: a new AI row. Entries $1b and $1f of ai_row_ptrs point here.

- **Entry of:** [`ai_row_ptrs`](../../tables.md#ai_row_ptrs)

<a id="ai_joystick_rows"></a>
### [`ai_joystick_rows`](../../../../src/ai/ai_tables.asm#L130) `$CA17-$CAC6`

*data*

AI joystick rows, 8 bytes each (23 rows). $8591 reads row n at $ca17+8n. Each byte is a joystick value: bits 0-3 up, down, left, right, bit 4 fire.

<a id="ai_joystick_row_22"></a>
### [`ai_joystick_row_22`](../../../../src/ai/ai_tables.asm#L156) `$CAC7-$CACE`

*data*

Not in build V 05 05 87: joystick row 22. Byte 0 of ai_row_01 selects it.
